scope: 29 committed preservation witnesses through the unchanged actual 52-test lane; one call of each original producer per original verifier call.
normalization: Only existing test_support.preservation canonical_surfaces/_canon_bytes/_view_hashes/html_meta and gallery_witness. No inverse-packing HTML normalization, old-U0 baseline canonicalization, excluded hashes or modified assertions.
outputs: Original pytest findings; all exact canonical surface docs/hashes, view sequences/deltas, returned HTML and raw SVG views; historical full recursive deltas explicitly distinguished from committed expected data.
baseline_recovery: Separate optional serial --lane baseline uses exact fff99e22 worktree, same observer. Only per-surface hashes matching committed manifest permit use as recovered canonical baseline. Failure/mismatch remains typed gap.
no_write: Only fresh scratch output roots; no guarded writer, active baseline/example/manifest artifact writes, approval or re-bless.
execution: Root runs --lane current31 after current pages and no overlapping test campaign.
If exact saved baseline documents remain missing, run --lane baseline serially.
Both require explicit reviewed frozen31 source manifest SHA256.
Exit nonzero retains actual preservation/test failure; packet_complete has separate meaning.
review_limits: Historical docs can be stale. Candidate versions copied expected metadata are explicitly not measured. Raw HTML retained but not automatically approved; no chips-only causation inferred.
saved_join: After optional baseline lane, compare-recovered.py validates both saved brackets and original surface artifact hashes, permits each baseline surface only when its canonical hash matches the exact committed expected row, then writes full current-vs-recovered recursive deltas in fresh scratch. All unreproduced rows remain explicit failures.
